about_the_game:
Thank you for playing my game.

Gameplay Overview

Customize your favorite guns and armor with powerful skill affixes. Choose your preferred rune abilities and build your own unique combat system.

Defeat enemies or use strategic items to earn coins, then spend those coins at various mechanical devices to reroll or upgrade your gear's affixes.

Face off against diverse enemy types and elite bosses that combine into ever-changing combat scenarios, testing your tactical rhythm and build effectiveness.

Key Features

Hundreds of skill affixes for limitless combinations(I’ll keep adding more—this is something I genuinely enjoy!) :
Whether it’s visual effect builds, zero-health armor builds, crit builds, gambling builds, status-effect builds, max HP stacks, or dodge builds—there are endless creative paths to explore.

Deep resource management mechanics:
Exchange health for coins, reroll gear affixes, purchase items and equipment… With limited resources, every decision matters.

Distinct enemy factions with unique identities:
Meteor-summoning elven mages, rapid-firing shadow archers, sword-wielding warriors, rampaging goblins… Each enemy archetype brings its own form of pressure and challenge.

Special mechanics tied to enemy types:
Many enemies in the game come with unique mechanics, such as:

  • Crystalline Shield: Each hit only deals 1 damage

  • Sequential Kill: Killing enemies in the wrong order will heal the entire group

  • Single Target Focus: You must defeat enemies one by one, or they'll recover HP

  • Resource Leech: While this enemy is alive, all players consume 1 extra ammo per shot

…and many more. These mechanics add unprecedented depth and variety to combat.

Feel free to share your thoughts, preferences, or feedback with me—I'd love to hear from you!
(If I don’t reply right away, I’m probably deep in development. It’s a solo project for now.)

Email: wp20200720@outlook.com
